issues.description: Attribute 'number_of_qubits_query_register' is declared as a floating-point literal in the template but as an integer in the solution. In template_repository/ex5_grover_kakuro.py the field is set to 0.0 (float), which will be passed to QuantumRegister and cause a TypeError or runtime failure. In solution_repository/ex5_grover_kakuro.py the same attribute is an integer (4). This mismatch is likely unintentional and will block students from constructing the QuantumRegister from the template.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template declaration to use an integer. Replace 'self.number_of_qubits_query_register = 0.0' with an integer placeholder (for example 'self.number_of_qubits_query_register = 4' or '0' if you prefer an explicit unset integer). Ensure the QuantumRegister is constructed with an int to avoid runtime/type errors.
